shipped_rows.title_o: Beyond Good Intentions: the development and evaluation of a proactive self-management course for patients recently diagnosed with Type 2 diabetes
shipped_rows.authors_o: Thoolen; de Ridder; Bensing; Gorter; Rutten

blind_target.evidence_quote: The study aimed to replicate prior research showing the intervention's effectiveness, and to extend it by (a) adding booster sessions and (b) prolonging the period of follow-up measurement to capture long-term effects.
blind_target.outcome_quote: The original intervention is effective, but the added value of the booster sessions is uncertain.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The conclusion supports the original intervention overall. Added booster sessions are an extension. The abstract does not identify the original citation; its number of original papers cannot be established.

luna_triage.reason: The abstract says this study retests prior evidence for the effectiveness of an existing proactive-coping self-management intervention and extends it with booster sessions and longer follow-up. It does not name the original paper or establish that the supplied Thoolen et al. (2007) article is the exact reported-effect source rather than a related course/intervention paper. Need the full Results/Discussion and reference context (or another source establishing the cited original) to resolve same-work equivalence and possible alternate citation/report representation.

quality_gate: Luna is triage only. Independently establish actual empirical retesting and absence under ALL shipped identities/alternate reports. Read prior objections. No paper outcome is being requested.
